name: mandate-monorepo
description: Pay agents for verified results, not attempts.

scripts.build: npm run build -w mandate-policy && npm run build -w mandate-bureau && npm run build -w mandate-escalation && npm run build -w mandate-receipts && npm run build -w mandate-sdk && npm run build -w mandate-mcp
scripts.test: npm run test -w mandate-policy && npm run test -w mandate-bureau && npm run test -w mandate-escalation && npm run test -w mandate-receipts && npm run test -w mandate-sdk && npm run test -w mandate-mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w mandate-policy && npm run typecheck -w mandate-bureau && npm run typecheck -w mandate-escalation && npm run typecheck -w mandate-receipts && npm run typecheck -w mandate-sdk && npm run typecheck -w mandate-mcp && npm run typecheck -w mandate-gateway
